_readme: Hand-resolved rows for the sheet reconciliation. The audit's fuzzy matcher
picks the best single element on the page; where the site splits a row across
elements, renamed a section, or removed an element entirely, a human has to
decide. Each entry below was verified against the rendered production page.
set    -> write this exact value into column D
review -> do NOT write; surface the row to Katie/Sean for a decision
This file should normally be EMPTY. It exists because the sheet had drifted
for months before the sync process existed. Going forward, column E drives
the site and column D is written back from it, so drift should not accumulate.
